tess_csm: Dropping a compact runbook we piloted with DeltaHealth this week. Focused on "tenant-level graceful degradation" and quick signals to prevent renewal churn. High-level, short and actionable.

kai_eng: Love this. Can you paste the condensed checklist we actually read on calls? I want to copy it into the Customer Portal card.

leah_onboard: Here's the 6-check checklist (2-3 min):
1) Verify warm_pool >= 8 for the first 2h of traffic.
2) Confirm prefix_cache contains top 20 prefixes from sample logs.
3) Prefill long tail cache for top 10 users (if applicable).
4) Set stream_fallback_threshold = 800ms.
5) Ensure client includes X-Client-Queue and idempotency-key.
6) Confirm feedback webhook configured for 24h and 7d ping.

nate_sre: Small engineering note: stream_fallback_threshold is evaluated on p50 first-token latency. We flip heuristics after 4 consecutive misses in 10m.

kai_eng: Minimal client header we recommend to customers:
```
POST /v1/chat/stream
Headers:
  X-Client-Queue: tenant-<ID>-<rand>
  X-Session-Hint: ui-<session>
  X-Idempotency-Key: <uuid>
  Accept: text/event-stream
```

tess_csm: Renewal-risk quick triage: the rule we used with DeltaHealth: usage drop >= 35% + p95 latency increase >= 200ms + negative feedback at 24h => auto-assign to AM with priority=high.

leah_onboard: For enablement cadence we used: Kickoff, 24h activation check, 72h perf check, 7d cost + feature adoption, 14d renewal-risk review.

nate_sre: Ops alerts to wire into tenant card:
- warm_pool_miss_rate > 4% over 10m -> create ticket and page if oncall == true
- streaming_partial_rate > 3% -> auto create follow-up, mark sessions as "non-streaming" temporarily
- prefix_cache_evictions > 50/min -> escalate to eng oncall

kai_eng: Prelaunch emulator script (tiny):
```bash
seq 1 200 | xargs -n1 -P10 -I{} curl -s -H "X-Client-Queue: tenant-$TENANT" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -d '{"prompt":"health-check"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate &>/dev/null
wait
```

tess_csm: Feedback capture payload we used in the pilot:
```json
{"question":"How useful was the response? (1-5)","meta":{"p95_latency":"${p95}","tokens":"${tokens}"},"webhook":"https://hooks.redwood.internal/cs"}
```
Send at 24h and 7d. Low scores -> create playbook task and ping AM.

leah_onboard: Extra tip: If a tenant shows cold-start errors during first 2h, enable short-term reserved capacity if available and increase warm_pool to 12.

go-live-bot: Playbook created: https://board.redwood.internal/play/11234 tags=[graceful-degrade, warmpool, feedback] :white_check_mark:

kai_eng: I'll paste the checklist into the portal and link to the pilot notes. Thanks!

tess_csm: Thanks team — looping in AMs for any follow-ups. :v:
